findings.containment: The attributed trace does not determine whether arrival means entry, duration, or equal intensity for all; it preserves the ordinary rescue and leaving claims alongside the shared-approach reading.

findings.reader_payoff: Kneeling becomes more than private subjection: it stages the collapse of the status metric used by the deniers immediately after the focus.
findings.containment: The status reversal is an attributed contextual inference. The live alternative is that 19:73-75 criticizes the evidence for status without defining the focus posture; the ordinary kneeling meaning remains intact.
